text:
maya: heads up — hit a customer onboarding failure on Cloudflare Workers with our JS SDK. auth header missing + retry seems to double-send. anyone seen this?
sam: yep. usually comes down to ESM/CJS bundle mismatch or a node-only retry helper getting bundled into the worker.
alex: can you share a tiny repro or stack? is this with wrangler/vite?
maya: wrangler 3 + vite. symptoms: "globalThis.fetch is not defined" in some builds, and when we do an auth POST that triggers a redirect the Authorization header gets stripped; our retry logic then issues a second request without auth so customer gets 401 + confusing logs.
jordan: Cloudflare Workers = web platform. no Node globals (net, http, Buffer). bundlers sometimes polyfill partially which creates weird runtime gaps. redirects dropping Authorization is fetch behavior by spec. retry lib probably does a plain fetch without reconstructing headers.
sam: agree. long-term fix is to publish an explicit web/edge build. package.json conditional exports so people on edge import the web-optimized entrypoint. e.g. add exports/exports map + a small runtime feature-detect in the SDK.
alex: also seeing TypeScript issues — our types leak Node types (Buffer, NodeJS.EventEmitter) which breaks tsc for worker projects. we should ship a web-typed index.d.ts or separate types entry as well.
maya: here's a quick package.json snippet I hacked that works for wrangler (notes inlined):
```json
{
  "name": "redwood-sdk",
  "exports": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/node.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/node.cjs",
    "./web": "./dist/esm/web.mjs"
  },
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "browser": {
    "./dist/cjs/node.cjs": "./dist/esm/web.mjs"
  }
}
```
maya: consumers can `import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk/web'` or bundlers will pick browser field.
jordan: for retries — implement an edge-aware retry adapter. key points: 1) only retry idempotent methods by default, 2) on redirect responses do not blindly re-send Authorization, 3) when re-sending reuse Request/Request.clone() so headers persist. example pattern: `const r2 = new Request(origRequest, { method: origRequest.method })` which keeps headers.
sam: fetch clone note: Response.clone() vs Request.clone() — we need request clones before body is consumed. in workers streams may behave differently. also prefer streaming-friendly code to avoid buffering.
alex: types fix idea: split types into types/node.d.ts and types/web.d.ts and use conditional exports to point types per entrypoint. consumers on workers get web types.
maya: i'll open a small repro repo and a GH issue + PR for the web entrypoint. posting repro in thread when done.
sam: quick onboarding doc idea to add to docs/devex: "Edge runtimes (CF Workers, Deno Deploy) — use /web entrypoint; don't bundle node-only libs; enable conditional exports". simple checklist.
maya: :thumbsup: creating tickets now. assigning alex for types cleanup, sam for packaging + bundler instructions, jordan for retry adapter. i'll reference the repro in ticket.
dev-bot: ci: build started for maya/edge-repro (sha: abc123) — 1 test failing (node-only-net-mock).
jordan: add a CI job using wrangler dev or a small integration test that runs the web build in a CF-like environment. catches these earlier.
maya: action items summary: 1) publish web entrypoint (conditional exports + browser field), 2) implement edge retry adapter + avoid retry-on-redirect, 3) split/clean types for web, 4) add docs + onboarding checklist, 5) add a wrangler CI smoke test. i'll create tasks and link PRs here.
sam: SGTM. thanks for flagging, maya.
